entities.summary: Thangtong Gyalpo, is also known as Chakzampa, the "Iron Bridge Maker", Tsöndrü Zangpo "Excellent Persistence", and the King of the Empty Plain. He was also known by a variation of this name, Madman of the Empty Valley. He was a great Buddhist adept, a Chöd master, yogi, physician, blacksmith, architect, and a pioneering civil engineer. He is considered a mind emanation of Padmasambhava and a reincarnation of Dolpopa Sherab Gyaltsen. He founded the Iron Chain lineage of the Shangpa Kagyu school of Tibetan Buddhism, and he recognized the first Samding Dorje Phagmo, Chökyi Drönma (1422–1455), the female incarnation lineage of Vajravārāhī.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Thangtong Gyalpo's innovative iron chain bridge designs and construction techniques had a significant impact on Tibetan trade and commerce, connecting remote regions and facilitating cultural exchange. His legacy as a master builder and engineer has endured for centuries, influencing the development of Tibetan architecture and infrastructure.
